headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 21, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. Dingler hit a home run (17) on a fly ball to center field, contributing to the Tigers' win. The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory, led by Sal Stewart's 2 hits and 6 RBIs. The Toronto Blue Jays secured an 8-6 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. The Colorado Rockies placed RHP Blas Castaño on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 18, 2026, due to a right pectoral strain. The Miami Marlins transferred RHP Josh Ekness from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right calf strain. The Athletics transferred RHP Luis Severino from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain.

The MLB has seen significant roster movement. The Atlanta Braves traded RHP Tyler Schoff to the team, while the Chicago Cubs acquired RHP Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded SS Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired C Joey Bart from the Atlanta Braves in exchange for RHP Hunter Stratton.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down White Sox 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. Dingler hit a home run (17) on a fly ball to center field, contributing to the Tigers' win.

top_news.title: **Reds Rout Yankees 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory. Sal Stewart led the Reds' offense with 2 hits and 6 RBIs, while Will Warren pitched 5.2 strong innings with 8 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Cubs 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured an 8-6 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win. Daulton Varsho led the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Rangers in Thrilling 6-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a hard-fought win over the Texas Rangers, outscoring them 6-4. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with a standout performance, going 2-for-5 with a home run and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Yankees 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with multiple players contributing to the win. Impact hitters for the Reds included Blake Dunn, Noelvi Marte, Tyler Stephenson, and Ben Rice, while Chase Burns was a standout on the mound.

top_news.title: **Brewers Take Down Braves 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 9-4 victory over the Atlanta Braves, led by strong performances from several impact hitters. William Contreras and Jake Bauers stood out for the Braves, while Sal Frelick, David Hamilton, Mauricio Dubón, and Rowdy Tellez contributed to the Brewers' win.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Blas Castaño Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-hander Blas Castaño has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain, effective retroactive to June 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Braves Bolster Bullpen with Trade Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have strengthened their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Tyler Schoff, acquired from the Washington Nationals in a trade.
